steps.name: Lumen
steps.objective: Travel to "Lumen" and turn in the quest to [Priest Miya].

steps.name: Invasion of the 2nd Lux Legion
steps.objective: Defeat [Wild Owlbears] and [Karka Assassins] in "White Col Canyon".

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Welcome to Lumen, adventurer. I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? I've only just arrived. You've been waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Please come this way. You've come looking for Lady Iris; it would be rude to keep you talking in the street.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Lady Iris arrived with Demigod Frozen and is staying under Lord Ziskad's protection.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: She said you might come someday, so I asked her to describe you in advance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris knows what I look like...

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: She said she saw you in her dreams. Her description was so vivid, and she said it felt as though she'd known you for a long time.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Perhaps that's why you feel familiar to me too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, where is Iris right now?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Lady Iris is training... Shall we leave that conversation for a little later?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: There's something we need you to do as soon as you've arrived. I'm truly sorry. This place is under attack by demons targeting Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: You must be tired after only just finishing your work in the Kingdom of Jude... but I hope you'll help us here.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: We're already dealing with the Deimos cult, and now Lux's troops have invaded as well. We have little choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll help. But just how many legions does Lux have? Even this is an enormous force...

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: The Third Legion is the one that appeared here.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: It's understandable that you're surprised. The Third Legion arrived alongside the Second, and we've confirmed that they've since moved elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: We're continuing to track the movements of the Second and Third Legions, but we don't have precise information yet.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: That's everything I know and all the information we've received so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: The East Land has always seen plenty of conflict, but fighting demons is unusual for us. Everyone is being cautious. That's why we're asking you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go out and assess the situation first.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Be careful. You've fought demons before, so you know, but the ones here are stronger than... Oh, already gone...

steps.name: Deputy Commander Eden
steps.objective: Talk to [Eden], deputy commander of the Lumen Defense Force.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Incredible. I believed you would be skilled, but I never imagined you'd return from the canyon so quickly.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: You're exactly as Lady Iris described you from her dreams.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris's dreams... I feel as though someone mentioned them before, but I can't quite remember...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: I think you should hear about your next task from someone else. Eden, who commands Lumen's main defensive force, has just returned.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Eden has protected this place for a long time. He's a splendid person, just like Lord Ziskad, the Sword God.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: He wanted to meet you too. What do you think? Oh, is something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: It's all right. Please tell me. If it's something difficult, I'll keep it secret...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Miya. Hearing you say that helps... It's nothing much. I thought I'd finally reached Iris, but it's taking so long that I started to feel anxious.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: If that's all, don't worry. Lady Iris is looking forward to meeting you too.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Adventurer? Are you all right...? You look a little tired. I'll cast a healing spell on you, so please relax.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Oh, right. Lady Iris feels sorry about this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She doesn't need to feel so sorry...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll meet when the time comes, won't we?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Yes. You certainly will. Have faith. She is the one who will become our goddess...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miya, I feel better thanks to you. I'll go see Eden now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait for me, Iris. I'm coming.)

steps.name: The Sword Empress's Battlefield
steps.objective: Defeat [Destructive Ettins] and [Snowy Mountain Lioras] in "White Col Canyon", then find [Ell] and report back.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I've been waiting. You're the adventurer Lady Iris mentioned... I've heard you've resolved many problems, from Jiendia to Freios.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Ah, I should introduce myself first. Some complicated matters kept me busy, so I'm a little late. I'm Eden, commander of the defensive forces at the Lumen alliance headquarters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eden, I'm %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eden offers a warm handshake and a friendly smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for welcoming me so warmly.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Normally, one should be cautious around strangers. But Lord Ziskad said to welcome you openly, since you'll be helping Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I'd like to travel with you and see your skills firsthand, but we're short on time, so I'd like you to get straight to work. I know it's a lot to ask, but I trust you'll be willing.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Now, go to Waterfall Tree Forest. Sword Empress Ell is there. Help her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is she?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Lord Ziskad's fifth disciple. Despite her youth, her swordsmanship is extraordinary. Even I doubted her abilities at first. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: She's truly exceptional. And she never neglects her training. I admire her for that.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Does that answer your question?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She sounds remarkable. But is she there alone?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: She seems to have wanted to investigate personally, so she obtained Lord Ziskad's permission.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: She isn't usually like that. Perhaps something was troubling her...

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: As I said, she went to Waterfall Tree Forest. The path is farther inside, so you shouldn't have trouble finding it.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Go and help her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We don't know what might happen, so I'll hurry.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Then we'll keep strengthening Lumen's barrier and searching for other enemies.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: ...Oh, already gone. Should I call that decisiveness, or impatience...?

steps.name: Sweep Them Away
steps.objective: Defeat [Owlbear Regulars] and [Berserk Ettins] in the "Waterfall Tree Forest".

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I sensed an aura unlike an ordinary person's and thought you were an enemy, but apparently not... Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (Ell looks surprised as she listens to %s's explanation.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I heard someone was coming to see Lady Iris. Anyone who has traveled this far alone must have real ability...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope I can be of help.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm sure you will be. You seem to understand the situation somewhat, so let's defeat the enemies here together.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Follow me. I know this canyon like the palm of my hand, so you'll have no trouble finding the enemy with me. Though of course, it would be better not to encounter them at all.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: We're only getting started, so steel yourself.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Impressive. When I heard you were an adventurer, I thought you were just an ordinary person. I never expected such skill.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: You really are the adventurer Lady Iris saw in her dreams...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dreams...)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What's on your mind? Stay focused. This is a battlefield.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: There's still much to do. Now that I've seen your skills, I'd like to trust you with another task. Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. Of course.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Then let me briefly explain Waterfall Tree Forest. It's an important place that retains the purity of the world's beginnings, where druids, elves, and other small communities live together.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That also makes it an important strategic position. If enemy reinforcements gather here while they hold it, Lumen will be in increasing danger.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Their leader is a birdwoman with violet wings. Defeating her should be enough, but there's one problem. I think you'll have an easier time facing her than I would.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Unfortunately, my sword can't reach an enemy in the sky. From what I saw earlier, that didn't stop your attacks from reaching them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In that case, I'll do it. But I'd like you to clear the way, Ell. This is my first time in the forest, and I might get lost.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Of course. I'll open a path so you can get inside.

steps.name: The Sword Master's Youngest Disciple
steps.objective: Talk to [Ell] in "White Col Canyon", then report to [Ull].

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: You've dealt with her. I knew you would...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: You certainly aren't an ordinary adventurer.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Thanks to you, the enemies in the forest are withdrawing. This is all your doing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I could only do it because you were with me, Ell. But has something else happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing else went wrong while I was away, did it?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The enemies withdrew, but someone went after them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Our youngest fellow disciple, Ull, seems to have seen them heading toward Jewel Tree Forest and rushed after them without thinking.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Sigh. I urgently contacted the alliance for reinforcements... but I think they'll take a while.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I've told him so often not to act alone, but he never listens. He even finds it too bothersome to ask our master's permission, as I did.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is the place Ull went?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Long ago, it was home to the greedy ancient dragon Gluat. As its name suggests, it's a mysterious place where enormous trees bear all kinds of jewels...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A place like that really exists...? But why are you so worried? Didn't he just go to finish off the stragglers?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Because Lux's Second Legion is stationed there now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Charging into the enemy's main camp alone... That's beyond reckless.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Our master keeps telling him not to obsess over fighting strong opponents, but still... Senior Sister Yuran will scold him later too.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Wait, something feels wrong... The enemies over there are moving differently. %s, do me a favor. I'll hold this place. You go to Ull.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I want you to get there and act before Ull makes a mess of things. Of course, he's strong too, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Jewel Tree Forest, you said? I'll head that way.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Good. The path to Jewel Tree Forest is... Already gone. I'm sure you'll find it...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, I'll deal with you. You'll pay dearly for coming after me...

steps.name: Shut Up and Charge!
steps.objective: Defeat [Pim] and [Veska] in the "Jewel Tree Forest".

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Stop right there. Who are you? If you made it this far, you can't be ordinary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm an adventurer who came all this way to help you...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The adventurer Lady Iris mentioned. Whatever. I don't need your help right now, so go back.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Otherwise, I'll cut you down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you just say? Did I hear that wrong?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'm saying I'm enough on my own. Just look ahead. So many enemies came after me, and now they lie cut down by my sword...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Ull stares at %s's face with an irritated expression.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I really was going to cut you down if you didn't leave, but you're still here. You and that woman Iris have something in common.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Even after hearing insults like these, you won't back down from what you believe you must do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Watch your mouth. Iris isn't someone you can speak about that way.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't like you. But I won't fight you here. I'd win anyway, but there's no need to do that on a battlefield.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Since you're here, I want to see what you can do. Go fight the enemies. And look for any trace of those Agasura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why should I do what you...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: If you'd stopped to consider that I might have information about Iris, you wouldn't be treating me like this. No more excuses. Help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a threat...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Think what you like. Well? What will you do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have much choice. I go farther inside, right? And deal with any enemies I find?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Exactly. You catch on well. I'll cover the rear, so don't worry about that. Just fight your way forward.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'll keep my eyes wide open and enjoy the show...

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: I can't believe it. To fall like this to a mere human... I won't make excuses. Kill me, human. Ending it here is best for everyone. So...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear what you have to say...

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: I have nothing to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux has plenty of enemies in the demon realm. Why did he come out here before dealing with them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is he targeting the girl who will become a goddess simply to rule this world? I'm asking because you're a legion commander. Don't you know anything? Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't you know, or don't you want to answer? Fine. Then I'll have to end this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I... I... Ugh... Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (My head hurts...)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Stand back, %s. Leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: You're the one who fought me before... Ull, was it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ull...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why... why did I act like that...?)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: (Step back and rest for now. Keep quiet about the Agasura.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Hey, white cat. I know all about your situation. Listen to me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'll set aside why beastfolk like you willingly entered the demon realm. You had no choice but to serve Lux to save your White Lion clan. But was it a good choice?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: After suffering wherever you went, I suppose that was the only path left to you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: If you die here, your whole clan is finished too, right? Answer me...

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: ...Yes.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Good. I've heard there are several groups in a similar position within the legions. I'll make you an offer, and you'll accept it.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I have a separate job for you, and I want you to do it...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Aren't you curious why I withdrew when we fought last time? I wanted to test your abilities.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You and the White Lion clan have more uses than I expected, so I gave it some thought. I especially want to make use of you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You're respected in the demon realm by Lux and by the troops under you. You'd make an ideal spy.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So I've decided. I'll use you, and in return, I'll take responsibility for sheltering your clan.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: All you have to do is choose.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: What are you talking about? Why should I?!

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'm giving you a chance to live on this land again. Let me explain once more. Even if you sacrifice yourself, your clan can dream of a future here again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ull, what on earth are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Stay out of it. This is between me and the cat.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Wouldn't a future with even a little hope here be better than dying pointlessly in the demon realm?

steps.name: Retake the Jewel Tree Forest
steps.objective: Report to [Eden], deputy commander of the Lumen Defense Force.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You've been helpful. I'll handle the rest. Go back and tell old man Eden that everyone withdrew along with Legion Commander Veska.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are you planning?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Something interesting. I don't know whether I'll actually do it yet. I'm only making plans for now. Don't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try not to concern myself with that. But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you tell me not to mention the Agasura?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You may not have noticed, but two red-haired people were watching us nearby. They seemed to be planning to spy on us and slip away...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: They ran off as soon as the demons moved. They're the ones, right? The ones who allied with the Kingdom of Moss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. The ones who used magic stones to brainwash the smaller tribes and make them attack the Kingdom of Jude...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Right, so that's it. That explains the strange things they had tagging along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I'm not sure, but they seemed artificial. Different from ordinary demons, and different from monsters too...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Interesting...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: But for things to stay interesting, those two need to show up again soon. They've gone into hiding, and that's no fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know much about Lord Ziskad, but why did he take Ull as a disciple?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (From everything I've heard, he's supposed to be an extraordinary person...)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What are you thinking so hard about? We've stopped their infiltration and repelled the demon attack. Is there something else wrong?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I wounded them badly too, so they won't show up for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go back and report. Leaving out what you did.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Good choice. I've told a mage named Asma about you. Go see her after you visit old man Eden. She'll open the path to the alliance headquarters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No need to look so surprised. I'm only doing what my master told me. And unless you intend to fight me and win right now, get going...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Sigh. Left without even hearing me out. Still, that power...

steps.name: The End
steps.objective: Talk to [Asma], the mage of Lumen.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: (After hearing the report, Eden looks noticeably relieved.)

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: I thought this would take a long time, so I'm glad it ended sooner than expected. That's thanks to you and the Sword God's disciples. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: What did you think of the Sword God's disciples? Hardly ordinary people, are they?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They certainly aren't ordinary.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: That's why people say the Alliance of Light in Lumen has a brighter future than the other powers in the East Land.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Once again, on behalf of the defensive forces, thank you for your hard work. Lord Ziskad has given you permission to enter the area containing the alliance headquarters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Of course. However, letting you inside isn't something I can do. A powerful magical barrier surrounds the headquarters, and only authorized people may enter.

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: For that, you'll need to see Asma. Do you see the mage over there with the jewels?

lines.speaker: 이든
lines.text: Apparently, Ull asked her in advance, even before Lord Ziskad gave permission. He told her to open the barrier and let you through as soon as she saw you. Hehe. Off you go, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I'll be going. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So Ull did that... I wasn't expecting it...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Oh, I've seen you going back and forth. You're %s, right? I'm Asma. Please, just call me Asma.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You're the person Lady Iris mentioned, right? Eden, Lord Ziskad, and Ull all asked about you, so I've been waiting. I'll open the barrier for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Asma... No, Asma...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've finally reached Lumen. Please let this journey end here...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You're authorized now. You can enter the barrier, %s!
